limits.projectName: Trim; 1..80 Unicode code points. Unique case-insensitively among projects.
limits.taskTitle: Trim; 1..160 Unicode code points; duplicates allowed.
limits.taskDescription: String, at most 2000 Unicode code points; defaults empty.
limits.dataset: At most 100 projects and 2000 tasks total; explicit 409 CAPACITY_EXCEEDED, never silent truncation. JSON request body at most 64 KiB.
limits.query: q trimmed, at most 160 code points, case-insensitive substring of title; empty q means no search filter. page integer >=1 default 1; pageSize integer 1..50 default 10. Reject duplicate/unknown query keys and invalid project/status/priority values.

canonicalModel.envelope: {schemaVersion:1|2, revision:nonnegative safe integer, nextId:positive safe integer, projects:Project[], tasks:Task[]}
canonicalModel.task: {id:'t-'+allocatedInteger, projectId:string, title:string, description:string, status:'todo'|'in_progress'|'done', dependencyIds:string[], createdOrder:allocatedInteger, priority:'low'|'normal'|'high'}
canonicalModel.idsAndOrder: One nextId counter allocates project/task IDs and createdOrder inside the transaction. It must exceed every allocated suffix/order; counters/revision cannot overflow safe integers. Never reuse an ID. createdOrder defines deterministic ascending task ordering; no locale-dependent sort.
canonicalModel.v1Disk: Envelope schemaVersion=1; task.state instead of status; no priority property. API presents status and priority='normal'. New I1 data is explicitly v1 to create a genuine compatibility baseline.
canonicalModel.v2Disk: Envelope schemaVersion=2; task.status instead of state; required priority. New data defaults to v2 after I4 contract task.
canonicalModel.decode: Strict shape/type/reference/graph/counter validation. Reject mixed state/status, extra fields, duplicate IDs/orders/dependencies, missing referenced project/task, cross-project edges, cycles, unsafe counters, and active/done tasks with incomplete dependencies. Corrupt/unknown-version file causes startup exit 1; never overwrite or initialize it.
canonicalModel.writeInput: Reject unknown properties, null/wrong shapes, readonly id/projectId/createdOrder edits, unknown status/priority and empty PATCH. Task create accepts projectId,title,description?,dependencyIds? and (after v2) priority?; create status is always todo. PATCH accepts title?,description?,status?,dependencyIds?,priority?; all supplied changes are atomic.
canonicalModel.blocked: Derived boolean: status is todo and at least one direct dependency is not done. Never a persisted status. 'ready' is explanatory UI text, not a fourth enum.
canonicalModel.transition: Allowed forward todo→in_progress→done, plus todo→done when all dependencies done. Reopen done→todo or in_progress→todo only if no direct dependent is in_progress/done. done→in_progress is invalid. Same-status is permitted with other edits, and standalone same-status is an idempotent no-op with unchanged revision. Any transition into in_progress/done requires all direct dependencies done.
canonicalModel.dependencyChanges: Same project, existing task IDs, no self edges, no duplicates, no cycle. Missing referenced task, self/duplicate/cross-project edges are 400 INVALID_INPUT with field dependencyIds; target task/project absent is 404 NOT_FOUND. Cycle is 409 DEPENDENCY_CYCLE. Editing edges on an in_progress/done task may not introduce any incomplete dependency (409 DEPENDENCIES_INCOMPLETE). Validate combined PATCH against final candidate graph and transition invariants, not intermediate field order.
canonicalModel.atomicity: Successful non-no-op command increments global revision once; a rejected command changes no disk bytes, revision, IDs or published memory state.

storage.files: data\planner.json, data\writer.lock; owned same-directory staged replacement file; migration backup planner.v1-backup.json
storage.lock: Exclusive create writer.lock before opening data. Hold for store lifetime. Store unique token + PID. Another open fails STORE_LOCKED. close removes only its own matching-token lock. No automatic stale-lock reclamation; user or test owner must prove prior process stopped before recovering owned directory. Do not delete another process's lock or unrelated files.
storage.transaction: Queue writes, compare expected revision inside queue, structured-clone committed model, apply synchronous domain change, validate complete result, encode, exclusively create staged file, write+file sync+close, atomic same-directory rename over planner.json, then publish in-memory snapshot. No awaited fallible operation after rename before publishing/result construction. Catch before rename cleans owned stage and leaves old bytes/state. Reads return cloned committed snapshots, never mutable internal references.
storage.recovery: After process termination restart reads complete old/new snapshot, never partial JSON. Do not auto-promote leftover staged files. Owned stages may be removed after acquiring exclusive lock and confirming they are not live. Response loss after commit is uncertain to caller; GET revision/content before any new action; UI never automatically retries POST/PATCH.
storage.guaranteeLimit: AC requires process-crash atomicity and serialization, not arbitrary power-loss durability or network filesystems. File sync is used; directory-sync semantics differ on Windows. C01 validates the supported local filesystem; failure is a storage design blocker, not permission to use truncate-and-rewrite.
storage.faultTests: Prefer real pre-rename filesystem failure (make the target destination incompatible in an isolated test directory) or a narrow file-commit dependency to inject error at write/sync/rename. Keep planner/server real. Assert exact prior bytes and subsequent successful transaction. Test commit-stage child-process termination with bounded synchronization and owned PID.

http.base: http://127.0.0.1:4317; CLI --port <0..65535> --data-dir <directory>; test port 0 prints actual address; no silent fallback on occupied fixed port.
routes: GET /, /app.mjs, /styles.css -> static allowlisted assets; no directory listing or data-file routes
http.taskView: Canonical task plus derived blocked; never expose disk state spelling. v1 API priority is normal; non-normal create/update/filter requires schema v2 and otherwise returns 409 MIGRATION_REQUIRED.
http.queryOrder: Validate → restrict project/status/priority/q with AND → ascending createdOrder → compute total → slice [(page-1)*pageSize,page*pageSize). Out-of-range page is 200 empty items with correct total. totalPages is 0 for no results. No implicit clamp in API.
http.dashboard: Counts use all tasks in selected project, never UI search/page filters. completionPercent=0 for empty else floor(100*done/total). blocked is a subset of todo, not additive to total.
http.concurrency: GET and writes return ETag '"<revision>"' and Cache-Control:no-store for API. POST/PATCH require exact quoted numeric If-Match, else 428 PRECONDITION_REQUIRED (absent) or 400 INVALID_REVISION (malformed); mismatch returns 409 REVISION_CONFLICT. Each UI reload obtains latest revision. Global revisions intentionally cause cross-project conflicts.
http.errors: {error:{code,message,field?},revision?}; validation 400 INVALID_INPUT/INVALID_QUERY/BAD_JSON/INVALID_REVISION; JSON media type required 415 UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE; body overflow 413 BODY_TOO_LARGE; unknown resource 404 NOT_FOUND; unknown route 404 NOT_FOUND; recognized route wrong method 405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED with Allow; duplicate name 409 DUPLICATE_PROJECT; graph conflict 409 DEPENDENCY_CYCLE/DEPENDENCIES_INCOMPLETE/ACTIVE_DEPENDENTS/INVALID_TRANSITION; schema readiness 409 MIGRATION_REQUIRED; write I/O failure 503 STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE; unexpected 500 INTERNAL_ERROR. Never return stack/path in response. Field-specific error is retained in UI.
http.localSafety: Bind IPv4 loopback only; reject nonmatching Host (127.0.0.1:<actual-port> or localhost:<actual-port>) with 403 FORBIDDEN_ORIGIN; when Origin exists require same allowed host+HTTP port. Absent Origin allowed for CLI. No CORS grants. Mutation JSON content type and Origin/Host checks reject hostile cross-site requests. Static CSP permits only self script/style/connect; nosniff and frame-ancestors none. Use textContent for untrusted titles, no HTML insertion.
http.lifecycle: Startup logs address and effective data directory, then health is checked once. Graceful signal stops accepts, drains bounded requests/writes and closes own lock. requestTimeout=10000ms, headersTimeout=10000ms; test-side AbortSignal.timeout(5000). Stop by captured PID/session, never process name.

migration.expand: At I4.T1 retain v1 writes while adding strict v2 decoder/encoder; canonical model uses status/priority; v1 maps state→status, priority normal. Do not write v2 until explicit migration.
migration.migrate: Stop server, acquire same writer lock, validate entire v1 input. Exclusive-create exact-byte backup; if it exists, require exact original-byte match before proceeding, never overwrite it. Convert all tasks state→status and add priority normal, schemaVersion=2, revision+1, preserve IDs/order/text/edges/status/counts/nextId. Atomic replacement. Existing v2 is no-op (no extra revision). Unknown/corrupt/locked inputs leave all original bytes untouched.
migration.contract: After v1 fixture and real-baseline conversion plus browser reopen/edit/restart checks pass, remove legacy encoder path and v1-writing consumers. Retain read-only v1 compatibility and pure upgrade transform; opening a retained v1 file allows reads but rejects commands with MIGRATION_REQUIRED. New empty stores are v2. Search app source/test/docs for state field and version-1 writing; remaining uses must be decoder/fixture/migration tests, not a production writer.
migration.compatibilityWindow: I4 is one deliverable increment with internal expand/migrate/contract tasks; no broken intermediate release. Old v1 app is deliberately not run against v2. No production rollout or distributed old/new coexistence is in scope.
migration.rollback: On isolated exercise data only, stop all processes and restore verified backup through atomic replacement; this loses post-migration v2 writes. Archive current v2 snapshot first if those writes matter. Never auto-downgrade or claim lossless rollback. Forward failure before replacement leaves v1 usable; after successful replacement prefer fixing forward.

scenarios: Fresh directory starts and health returns revision 0; browser opens Projects empty state.
Node run requires no production third-party packages; occupied port fails explicitly; clean close releases owned lock.
Example is outside benchmark/evals; API/static payloads match contracts.

criteria.outcome: Create and edit real project/task records
scenarios: Create Launch, Draft and Review; titles/descriptions survive fetch and full process restart.
Duplicate project name, blank/oversize text, unknown fields/IDs and wrong types produce exact errors without mutation.
Create/task-edit UI retains invalid input until fixed; save success is not shown before commit.
Two concurrent creates using the same revision yield exactly one success and one REVISION_CONFLICT; no lost IDs/updates.
Combined task PATCH either commits all fields once or none; a failed store write leaves exact bytes and memory/revision unchanged, and queue later recovers.
Second process cannot open same directory; corrupt/unknown schema is not overwritten; process termination around replacement leaves parseable old/new state.
Read snapshots cannot mutate owned state; no-op status does not increment revision.
Review depends on Draft; starting Review while Draft todo gives DEPENDENCIES_INCOMPLETE. Complete Draft, start/complete Review.
Self, missing, duplicate and cross-project dependencies fail; Draft→Review after Review→Draft produces DEPENDENCY_CYCLE.
Reopening Draft while Review active/done returns ACTIVE_DEPENDENTS; reopen Review then Draft succeeds.
PATCH status+dependencies validates final candidate atomically, independent of property order; done→in_progress fails.
Fixed F-query fixture independently specifies project/status/q matching IDs; page 2 of todo pageSize 2 returns E,F with total 4, totalPages 2.
All filters combine with AND; query case/whitespace normalization, empty/out-of-range and page/pageSize bounds behave as specified.
No duplicates/omissions across consecutive pages without intervening writes; filter change resets browser page to 1; no-result state can clear filters.

criteria.outcome: Dashboard counts are independent of paging
scenarios: F-query project Alpha has total 6, todo 4, inProgress 1, done 1, blocked 1, completionPercent 16.
Switching search/status/page does not alter project totals; global total includes the other project.
Empty project counts all 0 and completionPercent 0; successful status changes and restart update counts.
J1: create Launch→Draft→Review, edit title, reload/restart, confirm persisted labels and success feedback.
J2: add dependency, observe rejected transition, complete predecessor, start dependent, observe counts; reopen failure then legal reverse order.
J3: filters/page/deep link/browser Back and dashboard; J4: v1 fixture→offline migration→priority edit/filter→restart.
Keyboard-only labeled forms/cancel/navigation, visible focus, 390/1280px nonoverflowing layout, 44px targets, contrast and meaningful announced loading/empty/error/success.
Browser console/errors clean on all successful journeys; deliberate negative errors are captured and distinguished from uncaught runtime exceptions.
Malformed/oversize JSON, invalid media type and malformed/absent revision return defined statuses; unknown route/method handled.
Host/Origin rejection, allowlisted static files and text-rendered script-like task title; no data path disclosure.
Conflict UI retains draft and offers explicit reload; request failure has actionable error and retry/read, not success-shaped defaults.
Service and browser cleanup is PID/session scoped; no unrelated process killed.
I3 produces real v1 data; expand reads both forms while preserving v1 writes and API status spelling.
Offline migrate preserves exact backup, IDs/text/edges/status/order/counts and nextId; sets normal priority and increments revision once.
Repeat migrate is no-op; malformed/corrupt/unknown/occupied-lock/precommit-failure cases do not alter original.
v2 priority persists and filters after restart; legacy writing removed only after caller search; legacy reading retained with write rejection.
Exercise isolated rollback limit and source-aware resumed r2 plan; stale v1 proof is not reused to claim v2 pass.
Inject filter-after-page only in a copied known-good app; record hashes, diff and CONTROLLED FAULT label.
Original F-query HTTP scenario fails exact IDs/total, not setup; minimize one factor at a time to F-min.
Discriminate query parsing versus filter/slice order with same data different pageSize and request/source trace.
Retain behavioral regression, restore correct order, replay original/minimized and full release checks with independent observer.
No buggy production change/fault switch shipped; no claim it was naturally reported or a statistical prompt improvement.

criteria.outcome: Behavioral coverage of all 29 workflow inventory items
scenarios: Every inventory ID has an observation contract or justified conditional N/A; no phrase or file-presence scoring.
Actual research/planning/implementation/diagnosis/review transcript and source snapshots support exercised verdicts; absent proof remains NOT_EXERCISED/BLOCKED.
Independent verifier/reviewer reconstruct original cases and AC expectations; current local procedures, not installed old version, govern.
Headless approval, combined design/planning context, unavailable Python probe and any browser gaps remain visible.

criteria.outcome: Complete reproducible evidence without corpus contamination
scenarios: App unit/integration/browser replay scripts, README commands and fixture versions are persistent; exact commands/cwd/snapshot/results retained.
Existing native repo regressions and full fixed evaluation run separately; baseline failures are named, never rewritten to make example green.
Review covers final tracked/dirty/untracked app snapshot, semantic clarity, error/cleanup contracts and comment discipline; findings categorized and disposed.
No artificial diagnosis files in release tree, no unexplained data files, no unrelated workflow/benchmark edits. Publishing is parent-owned, not authorized by this design task.

F-query.construction: Create Alpha then Beta through API. Add tasks in label order A..G; capture returned IDs into label→ID mapping, never assume a fixed generated number. Use guarded revisions for every mutation.
F-query.v2Extension: After migration set E priority high and F low; Alpha + todo + q=launch + priority=high returns E only, total 1; dashboard unchanged.

F-min.construction: Same real HTTP server and disk; one project, first task done (A), second task todo (B).
F-min.faultSignature: Controlled page-before-filter implementation sees A then discards it, giving empty items. With pageSize=2 it includes B, which discriminates ordering from a status parser that never matches todo.

fixtures.F-v1: Capture a valid I3 store generated by API, including dependency graph and all three statuses; retain a redacted exact-byte fixture in test\fixtures\planner-v1.json and independent expected ID/text/graph/status/count manifest. Do not author only an invented legacy fixture and claim real consumer migration.

workflowObservationPolicy.evidence: Each observation records producer, independent observer, source snapshot, input, expected/observed result, command/cwd/exit, evidence references and limits. Planning a row is not executing it.
workflowObservationPolicy.causalityLimit: One app exercise demonstrates observed adherence/correctness, not statistical reliability, A/B efficacy or all future cases.
workflowObservationPolicy.finalClaim: Report counts by verdict and explicit N/A branches. Never title the report 'all features verified' while evidence/metrics/human gates remain missing.

workflowCoverage.observe: Inspect research delegation/tool transcript and clean source snapshot; confirm only authorized research artifacts, no nested agents/install/implementation. Parent records acceptance, not researcher self-award.
Resolve E17/E19 actual function→HTTP→assertion seam and scoped absence; compare every app AC to design/reuse choice. At v1 evolution inspect actual consumers and disk, not only old inventory.
Sample three source citations plus not-found claim; explicitly correct OS-temp inference, retain Python/browser unknowns; refresh new app schema/source claims at real r2 checkpoint.
This consumer used both research artifacts and opened current references/seams. Parent independently uses only linked artifacts, records sampled findings and full AC reconciliation.

Review planning lineage, exact snapshot, design assumptions and no source edits. Combined design/planning assignment does not exercise a separate fresh-context planner; disclose rather than claim that branch.
Each sequential slice produces user-visible result, due checks and independent gate evidence. Compare owned deltas/actual files, prevent shared-file concurrency and any broken 'completed' slice.
Incoming implementer executes first task solely from artifacts and identifies revision conflict/precommit failure boundary and stop action; parent audits every task/check field.
Resolve all links and graph edges, print each HTML at normal size ≤3 pages, full coverage review, record READY/REVISE/BLOCKED. Unmeasured print is not pass.
Review chronological red/green/snapshot proof; independent verifier differs from implementer. Future ACs remain partial and human approval unconfirmed; final reviewer re-derives all outcomes.

Pause at actual I3 disk/source checkpoint, resume from persisted state, adopt observed v2 delta as r2, stop dependents, invalidate v1-only v2 evidence, preserve IDs and recheck gates. If no real resume/reconciliation occurs, mark branch NOT_EXERCISED.
Sample actual readiness, slice, Python/browser blocker, migration and completion messages against current command/task state; no invented progress percentages.
Compare concise transcript with complete linked task/failure evidence; Python, print, approval and workflow-independence limits must remain visible.
Separate actual missing tool and defect output from suspected cause; perform owned setup/probes; no human wait in autopilot; finish exactly assigned scope without invented follow-up.
Reviewer independently traces PATCH→queue→graph checks→replacement→publication and failed-write path from final source; verifies one state/error contract owner.
Concrete normal/error paths and structural refactors preserve graph/transaction/cleanup assertions; reject speculative wrappers, not based on line count.

Inspect changed comments for necessary invariant rationale, stale status/migration descriptions and absence of incident logs. Runtime prompt/tool text modification N/A: no SKILL/reference/schema-for-tool edits in scope; application data schema is tested normally.
Readability findings carry exact source location, maintenance/behavior cost and proportionate disposition in the existing review record; no arbitrary fragmentation/comment quota.
Original seven-task public HTTP reproduction fails exact IDs/total in isolated labeled copy before correction; preserve inputs/transcript/snapshot.
Record one-factor minimization and query-size/source-trace discriminator; ordering cause supported by observation. Since injected cause is disclosed, do not claim a blind discovery experiment.

Design correction, intended red, repaired copy green, minimized+original independent replay, instrumentation cleanup; intermittent/performance branch N/A because defect is deterministic, no performance requirement.

Chronological focused behavior red→minimal change→green→refactor for each meaningful behavior. Runnable seams first; missing files/imports/dependencies do not count. Missing prechange proof remains limitation.
Stable public rule/store/HTTP boundaries; hand-worked F-query expected labels/counts; actual disk/backup/restart and browser consequences; no mock-everything passes.
Parent records D1-D6 dispositions; Windows replacement is isolated prerequisite, browser launch gates UI and Python metrics stay blocked; no downstream readiness inferred from assumptions.

Real v1 data + dual reader/writer window→backup/ordered migration→retire v1 writer only after caller search and compatibility proof. Deployed binary coexistence/production rollback N/A; single stopped local writer only.
Review todo/in_progress/done versus derived blocked, project-local edge semantics and realistic revision-aware caller. Reviewer verifies callers do not recreate coordination/invariants.
Parent evaluates JSON+lock versus SQLite and global versus per-task revisions using actual caller/failure burden, records rationale/disposition in existing design; no unnecessary ADR.

Before production wiring, owned experiment tests Windows same-directory replacement/held-reader behavior with predefined old/new-byte signal and bounded stop; result informs D2; remove throwaway source and preserve observations.
Full source base/head/dirty/untracked snapshot; independent review classifies SPEC/STANDARD/DESIGN CONCERN with basis, separates AC verdict from quality and explicitly reconciles final tree.

Observe loading current local references at their real phases, but editing workflow-trigger text is NOT_APPLICABLE: exercise adds only an app, not SKILL/reference changes. If parent changes workflow text, reopen design/plan and add real affected-branch verification.
